 (For Admission and Ia No.131551/2023-EXEMPTION From Filing O.T. and
 Ia No.131550/2023-APPROPRIATE Orders/Directions)
 Date : 21-07-2023
This petition was called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Surya Kant
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Dipankar Datta

For Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Siddhartha Dave, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Prastut Dalvi, Adv.
 Ms. Pallavi Sharma, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
We have heard learned senior counsel for the petitioner.

2. At this stage, the Investigating Officer has merely issued two notices to the petitioner under Section 91 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, asking her to furnish certain information for further investigation of the Case Crime No.64/2023 registered at Police Station Naini, Prayagraj under Sections 409, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The petitioner may, if so advised, submit her reply to these notices and in the event of any punitive/adverse action being taken, she will be at liberty to approach the appropriate forum in 12:54:58 IST Reason:
accordance with law.
